The projects below connect formal research questions with reusable modelling workflows, code, data documentation and reproducibility materials.

### GOBLIN-Spatial
A constraint-preserving spatial foresight framework for agricultural transition incidence, response potential and land-system transformability.

[Open project →](goblin-spatial/index.qmd)

::: {.feature-card}
### AGRISYN
Synthetic farm populations for reconstructing within-area agricultural heterogeneity from agricultural and spatial controls.

[Open project →](agrisyn/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### IFT-BioSim
Farm-level transition bioeconomic microsimulation for heterogeneous adjustment, opportunity costs, participation and policy design.

[Open project →](ift-biosim/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### BioLand-US
Contractual land access and prospective U.S. perennial-biomass mobilisation.

[Open project →](bioland-us/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### E-SEAT
Ethanol Spatial Exposure and Agricultural Transition, examining fuel-market reform and structural land-use persistence in the U.S. Corn Belt.
